pages.text: This page takes you from nothing to your first farming drone. You need iron, copper, redstone, a little gold and $(l)aluminum$(). $(l:materials/materials)Materials and Progression$(/l) shows where it leads next.
The $(l)CyberFarm$() tab of the advancements screen (press $(l)L$()) also shows where to go next: drones, power, and nuclear power up to the mech.

Every drone is built around a $(item)Drone Core$(). Every machine and module is built around a $(l:materials/circuits)Basic Circuit$(/l): craft your first ones by hand. Frames also need $(item)Rotor$()s and a $(item)Battery Cell$().
pages.title: 1. Craft the components

pages.text: Craft some $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frames$(/l) too: most machines need one or more beside them before they work.

Place a $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) and feed it coal or any other furnace fuel. It pushes FE into every machine touching it, or into $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l)s that carry it further.
pages.title: 2. Make power

pages.text: $(l)Look at any CyberFarm machine$() to see a small panel floating just over it. It shows whether the machine is working, the FE it makes or uses each tick, how full its energy buffer is and how far its batch has got. With Jade or WTHIT installed, that mod's own panel takes over.
Working machines also show it: their front lights up and moves, their lights glow in the dark, and some give off smoke, frost or bubbles.

Drone frames are made of aluminum.$(br)$(li)Mine $(l)Bauxite Ore$() and smelt the Raw Bauxite into $(l)Alumina$().$(br)$(li)Place an $(l:materials/electrolyzer)Electrolyzer$(/l) with a Cyber Frame on its left, and power it.$(br)$(li)Put the Alumina in: it makes $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum Ingot$(/l)s.
pages.title: 3. Make aluminum

pages.text: The Electrolyzer uses 80 FE/t and one Combustion Generator makes 60 FE/t, so use $(l)two$() generators. See $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum$(/l) for the details.$(br2)A $(l:materials/fabricator)Fabricator$(/l) beside it makes Basic Circuits two at a time, much cheaper than by hand.

Place a $(l:drone_systems/drone_assembler)Drone Assembler$(/l) next to the generator. Put a $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)Basic Drone Frame$(/l) and a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Harvester Module$(/l) inside, then press $(l)Assemble$().
pages.title: 4. Build the drone

pages.text: Place a $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Drone Dock$(/l) in the middle of your farm, also next to a power source (or connect it with cables from another mod). Right-click the dock with the drone to deploy it.
pages.title: 5. Give it a home

pages.text: By default the drone works a $(l)9x9$() area centred on the dock. To choose a different area, use the $(l:drone_systems/survey_tool)Survey Tool$(/l): click the dock, then two opposite corners. The tool reads what the drone does and tells you each step above the hotbar.
$(l)Look at a drone$(), even from up to $(l)32 blocks$() away, to see a panel over it with what it is doing, its charge and what it carries.
The drone brings everything back to the dock. Open the dock to take the items, or pull them out with a hopper or any item pipe.
pages.title: 6. Collect the harvest

pages.text: $(li)Learn more about drones in $(l:drone_systems/drones)Using Drones$(/l) and $(l:drone_systems/modules)Function Modules$(/l).$(br)$(li)Build better power in $(l:generators/generators)Generators$(/l).
